prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Some people have straight hair and some have curly hair. What decides whether a person will be born with curly hair or straight hair?
A. the type of hair their parents have
B. the type of hair their brothers and sisters have
C. their hair color
D. their skin color
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
